title: Building StoneEra with AI-assisted assets: physical cargo is now working in-game
author: Arrock12
selftext:
I’m developing StoneEra, a voxel settlement game. AI tools help me create some 3D assets; I review, edit, and integrate them into the game.

My latest implemented system gives crates physical contents and routes through the settlement. Villagers carry small containers, while large crates travel on an NPC-operated rail consist, move by crane, or ride on a cow-drawn cart. Rail stations can return empty crates for the next trip.

This video showcases the transport animations. I’d love feedback on whether the loading and crane movements clearly show what’s happening.

If you’d like to support development, [wishlist StoneEra on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/).
